description: Queue a fresh retry for one failed delivery (state failed), right away or at a chosen future time, without re-sending accounts that already succeeded. Call it only after the user says yes and any underlying issue (such as a lapsed connection) is fixed. Never retries a delivery whose state is unknown, queued, published or cancelled. Checks limits and network rules again; counts as one post on the plan.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this retry, 8 to 200 characters (a UUID works). Repeating the request with the same key answers the same delivery and never posts twice.

scheduledAt.description: When to retry, in UTC ending in Z. Leave out to retry right away; if given, it must be in the future.

name: jobs_retry
title: Retry a failed post
